stage: Exploratory same-weight continuous cross-term audit; old spectral event reused, nuisance assumptions unchanged

source_snapshot.interpretation: Exact archived source bytes are authoritative; HEAD may precede uncommitted development edits.

certificate_selection: Reuse this source run's certificate; no minimization over repeat certificates
scale_verification: Full vectors compared with source fit; reconstructed vectors and hashes stored

pilot_numerical_check.scope: Selected columns only; direct physical-cell exponential sums check NUFFT, axis order and half-cell phase. Scalar within-cell formulas shared; not a global floating-point pad.

pilot_refinement.scope: Analytic constant-cell Fourier moments; ordinary NUFFT/roundoff checks, no interval arithmetic

stress_scope: Saved joint-ball poses remain feasible for either set; no new product-ball adversaries searched
